programme.title: The Hub With Wang Guan
programme.desc: The Hub with Wang Guan covers hot-button geopolitical and economic issues, as well as interesting stories and trends in culture, education, technology and lifestyle. It aims to connect people, cultures and societies across the East and the West. The program features dynamic designs, fast pace and rich visuals to keep viewers engaged. It also makes use of trending topics online, while focusing on what’s relevant in China and the world.

programme.title: Joe
programme.desc: O atormentado Joe Ransom tenta esquecer o seu passado turbulento levando uma vida tranquila numa pequena cidade do Texas, onde conhece Gary, um rapaz de 15 anos, de quem acaba por tornar-se mentor e que acaba por defender de um pai violento e abusivo.

programme.title: Copshop Não Fazemos Prisioneiros
programme.desc: Em fuga de um assassino implacável, um astuto vigarista provoca distúrbios numa cidade pequena para ser preso e assim ficar escondido na esquadra da polícia. Só que o criminoso também acaba por ser preso numa cela próxima e a chegada de um terceiro assassino torna a situação ainda mais explosiva.

programme.title: Sequestro Nas Montanhas
programme.desc: Um grupo de cinco montanhistas a fazer caminhadas e escaladas nas Terras Altas da Escócia descobre uma menina sérvia enterrada numa pequena câmara numa zona deserta, e vê-se apanhado num aterrorizante jogo de gato e rato com os sequestradores da jovem.

programme.title: O Mistério De Jack, O Estripador
programme.desc: Um detetive e um médico legista juntam forças para resolver uma série de crimes horríveis na Londres da época Vitoriana, mas um deles esconde um segredo mortal.

programme.title: Pé De Cabra
programme.desc: Janet é uma dona de casa aterrorizada psicologicamente por um empreiteiro manipulador, levando a uma batalha distorcida de inteligências com resultados deliciosamente inesperados.

programme.title: Projeto 725
programme.desc: A filha do CEO de uma empresa de tecnologia é raptada por um grupo terrorista que pretende roubar o poderoso programa informático “Projeto 725” para causar estragos por todo o mundo. No meio do caos, só um destemido grupo de mercenários poderá evitar o pior…

programme.title: Uma Aventura Nos Mares - A 1ª Viagem De Circum-Navegação
programme.desc: A história da primeira viagem de volta ao mundo, que arrancou em 1519 e se iniciou sob o comando do português Fernão de Magalhães, numa crónica dos navegadores que se colocaram ao leme da História e mudaram o rumo da Humanidade.

programme.title: Respect
programme.desc: De criança que cantava no coro da igreja onde o pai era pastor até ao reconhecimento internacional, “Respect” acompanha a notável história de vida da cantora e compositora norte-americana Aretha Franklin e a jornada que efetuou para encontrar sua voz.

programme.title: Paraíso Distante
programme.desc: Shipp é um agente que tem de lidar com os dilemas morais da segurança na fronteira entre os EUA e o México, e Esmee é uma mulher sem documentos a lutar para fugir de um cartel implacável. Os seus caminhos vão cruzar-se ao tentarem salvar a vida de uma menina inocente.

programme.title: Sentido Único
programme.desc: Freddy é um pequeno criminoso em fuga com um saco cheio de dinheiro e cocaína. Ainda por cima, está gravemente ferido e tenta sobreviver a bordo de um autocarro, contra tudo e contra todos.

programme.title: Shenandoah - O Vale Da Honra
programme.desc: Durante a Guerra Civil americana, um fazendeiro da Virgínia jurou permanecer neutral no conflito, mas quando o seu filho mais velho é feito prisioneiro pelos soldados da União ele é forçado a agir.

programme.title: A Linha Do Horizonte
programme.desc: O piloto de um pequeno avião tem um ataque cardíaco em pleno voo rumo a uma ilha tropical. Para salvarem as suas vidas, Sara e Jackson, um casal de ex-namorados, terão de conseguir manter a aeronave no ar e encontrar o caminho de regresso a terra…

programme.title: Um Ranger Especial
programme.desc: Alex Tyree é um Texas Ranger que persegue o assaltante de bancos Declan McBride através do deserto, quando descobre que ele é um terrorista internacional que tenciona detonar uma bomba no coração de Londres.

programme.title: Um Polícia No Jardim Escola 2
programme.desc: Com a missão de recuperar informação sensível que foi roubada, um agente do FBI com mau feitio faz-se passar por professor do jardim de infância, mas o ambiente liberal e politicamente correto da escola torna-se cada vez mais insuportável para ele.

programme.title: Underworld - O Submundo
programme.desc: Numa guerra que dura há séculos, os vampiros e lobisomens lutam pela supremacia do Submundo longe do olhar dos humanos. Mas agora os lobisomens planeiam raptar um jovem médico humano para criar uma nova e invencível espécie. Apenas Selene, uma guerreira vampira, pode impedir este plano.

programme.title: Zona De Perigo
programme.desc: Abby Trent é uma agente da CIA que gere uma prisão clandestina de alto risco. Quando capturam Hatchet, o homem mais perigoso do mundo e um mestre na arte da fuga, ele inicia um jogo sangrento, eliminando os oficiais um a um. Abby descobre que está rodeada de traidores. Em quem pode confiar?

programme.title: Vendeta
programme.desc: Três amigos casados reúnem-se para um encontro anual de caça numa zona de deserto mas um deles traz consigo a jovem amante e a situação fica rapidamente fora de controlo. Deixada como morta no meio de um deserto infernal, a rapariga vai vingar-se e caçá-los um a um...

programme.title: Força Maior
programme.desc: Uma família sueca goza umas férias num resort dos Alpes Franceses, mas uma avalanche vai provocar o caos durante o almoço num restaurante na montanha, e as reações instintivas do casal vão causar uma fissura que pode provocar o fim da relação.

programme.title: Mato Ou Morro
programme.desc: O que fazer quando um casal de argentinos vigaristas morre na sua pousada do Rio Grande do Sul? Chamar a polícia? Ou enterra-los no mato? Esse é o dilema de Marcos e Carlo quando uma série completamente inesperada de eventos começa a acontecer.

programme.title: O Meu Pai Natal
programme.desc: No Natal, Antoine de seis anos vê o Pai Natal cair na sua varanda. O que não sabe é que este é um ladrão que se mascara de Pai Natal para assaltar casas. Apesar dos esforços para afastar o rapaz, os dois vão formar uma amizade improvável.

programme.title: Despedida De Casado
programme.desc: Um recém-divorciado tenta superar o trauma da separação através de uma enorme festa de “despedida de casado”.

programme.title: Vencer A Qualquer Preço
programme.desc: Um jornalista irlandês da área desportiva tem a forte suspeita de que as prestações do ciclista Lance Armstrong nas vitórias da Volta à França foram conseguidas à base de substâncias proibidas, o que o leva a procurar pistas que hão de revelar toda a verdade sobre o atleta.

programme.title: Kursk
programme.desc: A 12 de agosto do ano 2000, o submarino russo Kursk afundou-se no Mar de Barents, num desastre foi muito agravado por negligência governamental. Enquanto os marinheiros lutam pela sobrevivência debaixo de água, as suas famílias esbarram em obstáculos políticos e na impossibilidade de salvá-los.

programme.title: Vigaristas De Bairro
programme.desc: Quando Ray e a sua equipa de pequenos vigaristas reabrem uma pizzaria para poderem escavar um túnel por baixo dela e assaltar o banco que está na mesma rua, ninguém esperava que o novo negócio fosse um sucesso milionário, provocando uma reação inesperada dos vizinhos.

programme.title: Um Polícia No Jardim Escola 2
programme.desc: Com a missão de recuperar informação sensível que foi roubada, um agente do FBI com mau feitio faz-se passar por professor do jardim de infância, mas o ambiente liberal e politicamente correto da escola torna-se cada vez mais insuportável para ele.

programme.title: Perigosa Clarividência
programme.desc: Jian Huang é um agente da brigada de antiterrorismo com capacidades singulares tanto de artes marciais como de clarividência, que tenta investigar a verdade sobre a morte do irmão.

programme.title: Caçadores De Recompensa
programme.desc: Um famoso caçador de recompensas reencontra o seu principal inimigo, um fora-da-lei e um jogador profissional que ele tinha enviado para a prisão anos antes.

programme.title: Guardiãs Do Túmulo
programme.desc: Numa missão de salvamento do irmão, Jia descobre o túmulo subterrâneo de um antigo imperador chinês, que viveu uma vida estranhamente longa 200 anos antes de Cristo, só que rapidamente percebe que desenterrou também um segredo que devia ter ficado para sempre soterrado.

programme.title: Fidelidade Sem Limite
programme.desc: Com o brutal mundo do crime de Bruxelas como pano de fundo, Gigi, um gangster de aspirações elevadas, vive uma história de amor proibido com Bibi, uma jovem corredora de automóveis.

programme.title: A Quadrilha Selvagem
programme.desc: Em 1913, na fronteira entre os EUA e o México, um grupo de foras-da-lei de idade avançada procura fazer um último golpe e percebe que todo o mundo em que viveram, o do velho Oeste, está a mudar e desaparecer à sua volta.

programme.title: Os Ingleses Estão A Chegar
programme.desc: Harriet e Peter Fox são um casal de vigaristas ingleses que, após perderem uma grande soma ao póquer e ficarem a dever dinheiro a uma gangster psicótica, fogem para Los Angeles onde acabam por criar um elaborado plano para roubar um anel à rica ex-mulher de Peter.

programme.title: Donizetti - L’elisir d’amore
programme.desc: Riccardo Frizza conducts the Orchestra Gli Originali and the Coro Donizetti Opera in a performance of Geatano Donizetti’s comic opera L’elisir d’amore (‘The Elixer of Love’, 1832). L’elisir d’amore is perhaps the most famous work in Donizetti’s extensive repertoire. It tells the story of the poor peasant Nemorino who is in love with the beautiful landowner Adina.

programme.title: Waldbühne Concert 1992: French Night
programme.desc: The Berlin Philharmonic, conducted by Georges Prêtre (1924-2017), performs a French program during the Waldbühne Concert of 1992. The Waldbühne in Berlin is one of the most attractive outdoor amphitheatres in Europe and home to the Berliner Philharmoniker's summer concerts. With a 20,000 seat capacity, these events are some of the most popular classical music concerts in the world.

programme.title: England, my England - II
programme.desc: From August 28 to September 6, 2015, the Early Music Festival Utrecht was all about 'England, my England'. In line with this theme, presenter Lex Bohlmeijer takes the viewer on an intriguing journey through the England of the Middle Ages, Renaissance and Baroque, and relates this to the city of Utrecht.

programme.title: Johan de Meij - Echoes of San Marco And Fellini
programme.desc: This concert is the result of the collaboration between the Giuseppe Nicolini Conservatory of Piacenza and the Giuseppe Verdi of Milan as part of the project 'MIlanoPIACEnza ... suonare insieme.” On the program are works by the Dutch conductor and composer Johan de Meij. “Echoes of San Marco” is a tribute to the Venetian Renaissance composer Giovanni Gabrieli (1555-1612).

programme.title: IVC 2019 - Final: Schubert, Schumann et al.
programme.desc: Soprano Harriet Burns (United Kingdom, 1989) and pianist Ian Tindale (United Kingdom, 1990) perform Franz Schubert’s Verklärung, D. 59; Clara Schumann’s Er ist gekommen in Sturm und Regen, Op. 12, No. 2; ‘L’heure exquise’ from Reynaldo Hahn’s Chansons grises, and ‘Le printemps’ from Hahn’s Douze rondels; ‘Herzeleid’ from Robert Schumann’s Sechs Gesänge, Op.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Quartet No. 1, K. 478
programme.desc: Christian Zacharias (piano), Frank Peter Zimmermann (violin), Tabea Zimmerman (viola) and Tilmann Wick (Cello) perform Mozart’s Piano Quartet No. 1 (K.478) at the Ludwigsburg Festival in 1988. Mozart received a commission for three quartets in 1785 from publisher Franz Anton Hoffmeister. Hoffmeister thought the first quartet (K. 478) was too difficult and the public would not like it.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 6
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Shusha Renaissance (2023)
programme.desc: “Shusha, the Renaissance” is a musical journey featuring pianist Murad Huseynov. The city of Shusha is often considered the cradle of Azerbaijan's music and poetry and one of the leading centres of the Azerbaijani culture, having been declared the cultural capital of Azerbaijan in January 2021. On the program are the following works: Fikret Amirov’s (1922-1984) Twelve Miniatures for Piano Solo: I. Ballade - II. Ashigsayagi – III.

programme.title: IVC 2019 - Final: Schubert, Wolf et al.
programme.desc: Soprano Erika Baikoff (United States, 1994) and pianist Gary Beecher (Ireland, 1993) perform Franz Schubert’s ‘Suleika I, Was bedeutet die Bewegung’, Op. 14, No. 1 (D. 720); Die Blumensprache, Op. 173, No. 5 (D. 519); and, Die Gebüsche, D. 646; ‘Lied vom Winde’ and ‘Der Knabe und das Immlein’ from Hugo Wolf’s Mörike-Lieder; ‘Fleur jetée’ from Gabriel Fauré’s Quatre melodies, Op.

programme.title: The Violin's Voice
programme.desc: How can we describe the intimate connection between an instrument and its player? World renowned violinist Frank Peter Zimmerman refers to his 1711 Stradivarius 'Lady Inchiquin' as the 'love of his life,' but what does it take for a piece of wood to achieve such reverential status?

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final I: Chopin and Mozart
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Handel - Messiah, HWV 56
programme.desc: The Messiah (HWV 56) by Georg Frederich Handel, also known as “A New Sacred Oratorio”, tells the life and suffering of Christ: a story of passion, fire, and sacrifice. This is one of Handel's best-known works, which took only three weeks to compose this oratorio and its famous 'Hallelujah'. The work has immense popularity since its premiere in Dublin in 1742, and is often presented at Easter.

programme.title: Works by Smetana, Janácek, Suk and Dvorák
programme.desc: Musicians of the Reina Sofía School of Music pay tribute to the rich musical heritage of Czechia in this chamber concert. The program features Bedrich Smetana’s Piano Trio in G minor, performed by violinist Eduard Kollert, cellist Célia Garetti Nicole, and pianist Mariam Chitanava. Pianist Natalie Schwamova takes the stage for Leoš Janácek’s Piano Sonata 1.X.

programme.title: England, my England - I
programme.desc: From August 28 to September 6, 2015, the Early Music Festival Utrecht focused on England, my England. On the basis of the festival theme, presenter Lex Bohlmeijer takes the viewer in a two-part documentary on an intriguing journey through England of the Middle Ages, Renaissance and Baroque, and relates this to the city of Utrecht.

programme.title: Beethoven - Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20
programme.desc: The soloists from the Lucerne Festival Orchestra present Ludwig van Beethoven’s Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20, which is scored for clarinet, horn, bassoon, violin, viola, cello and double bass. This 1799 piece achieved great popularity during Beethoven’s lifetime.

programme.title: Mozart - Violin Concerto No. 5
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Violin Concerto No. 5 in A major, K. 219, also known as the ‘Turkish Concerto’. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist.

programme.title: The Argonauts - Quest for the Golden Fleece
programme.desc: In 1419 Philip the Good inherits a realm stretching from Dijon to deep into the Netherlands. In 1430, he founds his Order of the Golden Fleece, which enables him to give form to and to maintain both his knightly ideals and his political relations.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Piano Concerto No. 4 And Nielsen 6th
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in this powerful performance taken from the 150th Anniversary celebrations of Denmark’s national composer, Carl Nielsen. Alongside Nielsen’s inscrutably ironic Symphony No. 6, this performance features world-renowned French pianist Lise de la Salle as soloist in Rachmaninov’s Piano Concerto No. 4.

programme.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra in Gustav Mahler’s poignant song cycle ‘Das Lied von der Erde’ (The Song of the Earth). Joining him are two of today's leading vocalists: mezzo-soprano Magdalena Kožená and tenor Andrew Staples. Written in the final years of his life, Mahler’s masterpiece contemplates the beauty of life and the sorrow of parting through some of his most personal and beautiful symphonic writing.

programme.title: Prosseda performs Mozart, Schubert And Chopin
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: B. Strozzi - Sino alla morte
programme.desc: Argentinian conductor and harpsichordist Leonardo García Alarcón leads his ensemble Cappella Mediterranea in a program of Italian Baroque music. The ensemble performs some of the finest Baroque pieces composed by Francesco Cavalli, a prominent composer in 17th-century Venice, and two of his famous students, Barbara Strozzi and Antonia Bembo. Argentinian soprano Mariana Flores presents the vocal works.

programme.title: Teatro Regio behind the scenes
programme.desc: Few Italian theatres can boast of being an absolute point of reference for national and world culture. The Teatro Regio in Turin is both a symbol of excellence in the national operatic tradition and a prestigious stage hosting operas, ballets, concerts, and musicals of great substance.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37. Russian-born pianist Maya Oganyan (*2005) makes her solo debut with the orchestra. Beethoven composed this concerto in 1800 and played the piano part himself at the piece’s premiere in 1803. Like two of his other major works –Symphony No. 5 and Piano Sonata No.

programme.title: Monteverdi - Madrigals, Book III
programme.desc: Italian composer Claudio Monteverdi (1567-1643) composed nine books of madrigals in half a century, which helped transform the genre from the polyphonic, a cappella madrigals of the late Renaissance to the ‘concertato’ madrigals of the early Baroque, shifting the style’s focus to the ability of music to express emotions contained in a text.

programme.title: A Tribute to Vienna
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron.

programme.title: Verdi - Messa da Requiem
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi’s Messa da Requiem, recorded at the Parco Ducale di Parma, Italy as part of Festival Verdi 2020. The soloists are soprano Eleonora Buratto, mezzosoprano Anita Rachvelishvili, tenor Giorgio Berrugi, and bass Roberto Tagliavini.

programme.title: Bach - St. John Passion
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the marvelous Berliner Philharmoniker and performs Johann Sebastian Bach's splendid St. John Passion. The solo voice parts are sung by the renowned soloists Juliane Banse, Michael Chance, Ian Bostridge, Rainer Trost and Thomas Quasthoff. Also joining is the famous RIAS Kammerchor. Bach composed his passion, based on the Gospel of John, during his first year as director of church music in Leipzig.

programme.title: Napoli - Music's forgotten capital -I
programme.desc: In the summer of 2019, the Utrecht Early Music Festival explored the musical legacy of Naples: a cultural metropolis of contradiction and solidarity. In the documentary 'Napoli – Music’s Forgotten Capital', festival co-curator Thomas Höft unearths riveting tales from this multi-faceted city.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final II: Mozart and Bartók
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Sounds like Christmas
programme.desc: Set in the magnificent Cistercian Monastery Schulpforte near Naumburg, Germany, Sounds like Christmas combines festive music with the spontaneity and freshness of jazz. This Christmas program is the musical encounter between soprano Angelika Kirchschlager and jazz trumpeter Tomasz Stanko.

programme.title: Haydn - Symphony No. 45 'Farewell'
programme.desc: Under the direction of Conrad van Alphen, the Sinfonia Rotterdam Orchestra performs Haydn's Symphony No. 45 at the Nieuwe Kerk (New Church) in The Hague. This piece is nicknamed 'Farewell' because of a funny anecdote. Haydn and his musicians stayed every year from May to October at the magnificent Esterháazy Palace, at the request of Prince Nicholas.

programme.title: Vocal baroque works by Cavalli, Strozzi And Bembo
programme.desc: Argentinian conductor and harpsichordist Leonardo García Alarcón leads his ensemble Cappella Mediterranea in a program of Italian Baroque music. The ensemble performs some of the finest Baroque pieces composed by Francesco Cavalli, a prominent composer in 17th-century Venice, and two of his famous students, Barbara Strozzi and Antonia Bembo. Argentinian soprano Mariana Flores presents the vocal works.

programme.title: Mendelssohn - Trio No. 1 Op. 49
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich, violinist Tedi Papavrami and cellist Mischa Maisky perform Felix Mendelssohn’s Piano Trio No. 1 in D minor, Op. 49.

programme.title: Music of Naples
programme.desc: Throughout the centuries, the Italian city of Naples has proved to have a remarkably favorable climate for artistic innovation. The presence of the royal or vice royal courts, the practice of music in churches, fraternities, and charitable institutions, financial support from well-to-do citizens, and the popularity of song and dance in public life made for an extraordinarily diverse musical landscape.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22. The composer completed the work in 1838. Of Schumann’s three piano sonatas, Piano Sonata No. 2 is performed and recorded most frequently.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 10
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 10 is an unfinished work left by the composer at his death, representing his ultimate emotional journey from torment and heartbreak to an unreserved acceptance of life and human love.

programme.title: Kristine Opolais Recital
programme.desc: Critics praise her, and the audience loves her. Kristine Opolais, the prima donna and the star of the New York Metropolitan Opera, performs in her home country Latvia. She gives a splendid concert with the Latvian National Symphony Orchestra, at the Latvian National Opera, in 2017. The program includes arias from operas that made Kristine an international star.

programme.title: The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Elias Ackerley
programme.desc: Pianist Elias Ackerley (United Kingdom/South Korea, 2001) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Allegro molto moderato, of Gabriel Fauré’s Piano Quartet No. 1 in C minor, Op. 15.

programme.title: Symphony No. 3, in D minor
programme.desc: Mahler's Third Symphony, composed between 1895 and 1896, is an expansive, programmatic work that explores themes of nature, humanity, and spiritual ascent. It features a massive orchestra, a female choir, a children's choir, and a mezzo-soprano soloist, creating a vast soundscape depicting everything from nature's beauty to deeper philosophical questions about existence.

programme.title: Ravel - Piano Concerto in G major
programme.desc: Mikhail Pletnev leads the Russian National Orchestra in a performance of Maurice Ravel's Piano Concerto in G major, featuring Lucas Debargue as the soloist. The composer completed this lively three-movement Piano Concerto in 1931. He incorporated several jazz elements in the work, especially in the two outer movements.

programme.title: Balanchine
programme.desc: In this compilation of enchanting choreographies by George Balanchine, the New York City Ballet pays tribute to the man who founded the dance company in 1948 together with Lincoln Kirstein.

programme.title: Works for lute by J. S. Bach
programme.desc: French lutenist Thomas Dunford performs various works for lute by J. S. Bach in this intimate chamber music concert, recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, in 2017. On the program are Suite for lute in G minor, BWV 995; Suite for solo cello in G major (arr. for lute), BWV 1007; and Chaconne from Partita for solo violin in D minor (arr. lute), BWV 1004.

programme.title: Bacchetti performs Bach, Haydn and Mozart
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti appears both as conductor and soloist in this concert recorded at Teatro Chiabrera in the Italian city of Savona. He is accompanied by I Musici di Parma. On the program are J. S. Bach’s Prelude and Fugue in E major, BWV 878 (The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book II, No. 9), Joseph Haydn's Piano Concerto No. 11 in D major (Hob.

programme.title: Liszt - Totentanz, S. 525
programme.desc: Russian pianist Dina Ivanova performs Franz Liszt’s Totentanz, S. 525, during the Solo finals of the 11th International Franz Liszt Piano Competition, held at TivoliVredenburg in Utrecht, the Netherlands. Totentanz (Dance of Death) is one of Liszt’s many works that reflect the Romantic composer’s fascination with death. The piece is a series of variations on the macabre Gregorian Dies irae theme.

programme.title: Brahms - Tragic Overture in D minor, Op. 81
programme.desc: Manfred Honeck conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Brahms' Tragic Ouverture, Op. 81 during the Easter Concert in Baden-Baden 2016.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - The Nutcracker
programme.desc: Tchaikovsky's The Nutcracker is one of the best known and most beloved pieces from the composer. The music has inspired many choreographers to the tell the colourful Christmas fairy-tale of E. T. A. Hoffmann and Alexandre Dumas senior in the language of dance. Ben Stevenson is to this day considered one of the most important influencers of the American ballet art.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Violin Concerto No. 1, Op. 77
programme.desc: In May 2019, the new principal conductor of the Gewandhaus, Andris Nelsons, presented Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 5 with his orchestra in combination with Shostakovich’s Violin Concerto No. 1 with outstanding violinist Baiba Skride as the soloist.

programme.title: Bach - Cello Suite No. 5 in C minor, BWV 1011
programme.desc: At St. Bartholomew Church in Dornheim, Germany, where composer Johann Sebastian Bach married his first wife Maria Barbara, renowned Dutch cellist Anner Bijlsma performs the composer's Cello Suite No. 5 in C minor, BWV 1011. It is likely Bach wrote his collection of six Suites for unaccompanied cello during the years 1717-1723.

programme.title: Stravinsky - Le Sacre - I. L'Adoration de la Terre
programme.desc: Every year, the Europakonzert is hosted by the Berliner Philharmoniker in a notorious concert hall or on a special location. This years concert is performed at the magnificent Royal Albert Hall in London. The Dutch conductor Bernard Haitink closes with Stravinsky's The Rite of Spring which he wrote in 1913 for Sergei Diaghilev's Ballets Russes.

programme.title: Handel - The Triumph of Time and Truth
programme.desc: Emmanuelle Haim conducts Le Concert d’Astrée in a rendition of G. F. Handel’s two-part oratorio “Il Trionfo del Tempo e del Disinganno” (The Triumph of Time and Truth). The work with a libretto by Benedetto Pamphili was first performed in Rome, in 1707. Director Krzysztof Warlikowski has taken Handel’s first oratorio, written when the composer was only 22 years old, on in a deep, tender staging.

programme.title: Waldbühne 2000 - Rhythm and Dance
programme.desc: The annual summer concert given by the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra at the Waldbühne is a legendary event. The Millenium concert, recorded live on June 25, 2000, brought together more than 22,000 spectators in one of Europe's most beautiful outdoor amphitheaters.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces - Concerto for Orchestra
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Bela Bartok’s ‘Concerto for Orchestra’ is discussed.

programme.desc: No final de verão, Ulisses é colocado numa pequena cidade perto da costa para ocupar o cargo de professor de literatura. Aí vai descobrir toda a sensualidade do Mediterrâneo através do mar, dos cheiros inquestionáveis da natureza e das deliciosas refeições preparadas por uma bela mulher. O professor apaixona-se por Martina, mas ela já está comprometida e com data marcada de casamento com um rico empresário da região.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 29
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Segure Minha Mão T1 - Ep. 19
programme.desc: A história gira em torno de uma garota chamada Azra, que está estudando no exterior, na América, para se tornar cozinheira profissional, assim como seu pai.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 25
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 63
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 30
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 64

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.

programme.title: Dave Brubeck and Paul Desmond live in Belgium
programme.desc: Dave Brubeck: Live in '64 boasts a beautifully filmed concert from one of the most beloved quartets in jazz history.

programme.title: A$AP Rocky And A$AP Ferg - At The Hordern Pavilion
programme.desc: Big hits, booty dancing, stage dives, fan freestyles and of course, controversy, A$AP Rocky's debut Down Under tour had it all! At his sold-out Sydney show, hip hop's hottest star and 5000 rowdy fans got wild for the night at the Hordern Pavilion and we captured it all exclusively.

programme.title: Tivoli Utrecht: Sven Hammond Soul
programme.desc: Although its music might sound like the sound track of any 1970s American car chase movie, the band Sven Hammond Soul is from the Netherlands. This steaming soul machine is headed by Sven Figee, who prefers to attack rather than play his Hammond organ. In April 2012, the band was augmented with vocalist Jenny Lane. Today’s recordings were made at a steaming live performance at Utrecht’s Tivoli in 2012.

programme.title: Portrait: Urgent Detergent
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Playa del Carmen
programme.desc: This broadcast shows a rare appearance at the 1996 Germeringer Jazztage by the legendary flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía and his sextet. Some may question the inclusion of a flamenco guitarist within a jazz festival.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Montreux
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Terrasson And Belmondo: À Nous Garo
programme.desc: Every year, the Jazz en Baie festival takes place in the beautiful bay of Mont Saint-Michel Today’s broadcast shows a special gathering between two grandmasters of French jazz: pianist Jacky Terrasson and trumpeter Stéphane Belmondo. The two team up for an amazing concert in which jazz is combined with soul and a touch of chanson française.

programme.title: Gil Evans, Ornette Coleman - Schloss Ansbach
programme.desc: This program presents two concerts from Schloss Ansbach in 1978. The first concert features Gil Evans and his orchestra, consisting of Gil Evans on piano, Steve Lacy on soprano saxophone, Arthur Blythe on alto saxophone, Pit Levin on synthesizers, Earl McIntyre on trombone, Lewis Soloff on trumpet, Geoffrey Berlin on bass and Sue Evans on percussion instruments.

programme.title: Visions of Music: Carnet des Routes
programme.desc: Visions of Music - World Jazz invites the viewer on a journey to the roots of music, introducing the enormous impact that traditional music from around the world has had on contemporary jazz. This program features legendary musicians such as BB King, Dino Saluzzi, Tito Puente, Carlos Santana, Zawinul Joe, Manu Dibango, Abdullah Ibrahim, as well as new generation representatives such as Nicholas Payton, Cyro Baptista, and Don Byron.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Richard Bona
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Fats Domino - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. American singer and pianist Fats Domino gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival of 1980.

programme.title: Seun Kuti And Egypt 80 - Cabaret Sauvage
programme.desc: Seun Anikulapo Kuti possesses the grace, energy and fury of his father, the legendary artist Fela Kuti. With the musicians of Fela Kuti’s legendary band Egypt 80, Seaun Kuti brings the most original incarnation of Afrobeat to life. Digging deep into different African traditions, Seun has brought his own touch to the music by reflecting the difficulties and cultures of the continent.

programme.title: Live at Beck’s Festival Bar
programme.desc: The UK based band Metronomy started out as a bedroom project by Joseph Mount, who during its early stages was the sole contributor to the band's repertoire. After the debut release, Mount started expanding the band's personnel: first by adding two members, and later increasing it by one more.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Duke Ellington Orchestra - Het Concertgebouw
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: The Skymasters with Clark Terry - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1989, Dutch big band and radio orchestra The Skymasters took flight at the North Sea Jazz Festival in the Hague.

programme.title: Huu Bac Quintet Live in Canada '15
programme.desc: Huu Bac left Vietnam for Quebec at the age of two. This musician was first interested in jazz guitar, then in dan bau, an old monochord musical instrument, central to the folk music of Vietnam. Huu Bac's curiosity about ancient instruments led him to the Shanghai Conservatory of Music, where he studied erhu, a traditional Chinese string instrument. Bac's work combines classical repertoire and Western influences.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Cavaliere and Mohy Duo
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music.

programme.title: Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham And Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers’ came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Jazz a Juan
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Everything I Say (Magnolia)
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. One of them is Dutch singer, pianist, composer and bandleader Ruben Hein. Widely praised for his warm and characteristic voice and his offbeat piano playing, Ruben Hein is the artistic director and conductor of the National Youth Jazz Orchestra (NJJO).

programme.title: Christian McBride - Brother Malcolm
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: I Will Not Be Sad
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival, held in Osnabrueck, has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. Jivan Gasparyan Jr has always been inspired by the folk melodies of his native Armenia.

programme.title: Crossroads: From Blues to Bossa
programme.desc: A two-part documentary, moderated by Dee Dee Bridgewater. Part 1: From Blues to Bossa On the search for the roots and origins of Jazz, we journey into the European and African music traditions and discover the cultural heritages of Jazz from Rio to New Orleans.

programme.title: Os Capoeira - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is Os Capoeira.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2023 interview
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. programme.title: Charles Mingus And Eric Dolphy live in Liège
programme.desc: Charles Mingus showcases an exceptional concert performed in April 1965 featuring his most celebrated lineup: Jaki Byard (piano), Dannie Richmond (drums), Johnny Coles (trumpet), Clifford Jordan (tenor sax) and the great Eric Dolphy (alto sax, flute and bass clarinet).

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: I Wouldn't Give a Cripple Crab a Crutch
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential male jazz and pop vocalists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Delight in the expressive beauty and emotional depth of Chet Baker's rendition of “Time After Time” and “You Don't Know What Love Is', recorded live in Brussels, Belgium in 1964 and in Rome, Italy in 1956 respectively.

programme.title: Bakolo Music International - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Ghatam, Kanjira And Morsing: Nandi
programme.desc: The trio ‘Nandi’ is made up of the Indian master percussionist Ghatam Suresh, bassist Pascal Lovergne, and pianist Stefan Orins. They give the tried-and-true piano-bass-drums format a fresh new sound by blending jazz with South Indian Carnatic rhythms and melodies. These various musical worlds complement and enhance each other, in a perfectly balanced mix.

programme.title: Bill Evans' European Tour: Live in '64, '65 And '70
programme.desc: Bill Evans: Live in '64, '65 And '70 features five separate performances by one of the most revered pianists in music history. This collection covers an 11-year span, highlighting Evans’ ever-deepening artistry as he performs with four different all-star rhythm sections, including the stunning duo of bassist Niels-Henning Ørsted Pedersen and drummer Alan Dawson.

programme.title: Come Twogether ft. Benjamin Herman
programme.desc: Instead of children’s songs, the sound of jazz standards was always present. They practiced intricate drum rhythms instead of Bach etudes: Simon Oslender and Jérôme Cardynaals have jazz running through their veins! Under the name ‘Twogether’ both youngsters celebrate a very unique and soulful style of funky blues-jazz. They create a sound that leaves even renowned jazz artists speechless.

programme.title: Jack DeJohnette's Special Edition at Estival 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Jack DeJohnette, an important figure in jazz fusion, was inducted into the Modern Drummer Hall of Fame in 2007.

programme.title: John Lurie: A Lounge Lizard Alone
programme.desc: In 1978, John Lurie formed The Lounge Lizards jazz ensemble with his brother Evan; the pair played music together for 20 years. However, in this New Year's Eve performance, Lurie (saxophone) plays a legendary show with drummer Larry Wright. Lurie is a musician, actor, painter, and the driving force behind the Strange And Beautiful music label.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: A Trace of Grace
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong: Live in Australia
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly!

programme.title: The Tällberg Foundation: 'Jazz for the Planet'
programme.desc: On October 19, 2021, John Patitucci (bass), Marco Pignataro (sax and musical director), and Joe Lovano (sax) showcased inspirational new originals at GBH's Fraser Performance Studio in Boston, MA, accompanied by Terri Lyne Carrington (drums), Nadia Washington (vocals), Chico Pinheiro (guitar), and Anastassiya Petrova (piano).

programme.title: Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Chucho Valdes - Jazz a Vienne
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne’ is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them were Chucho Valdes and his Afro-Cuban Messengers, the prime example of Latin-inspired jazz music.

programme.title: Sven Hammond Soul: Tivoli de Helling
programme.desc: Although its music might sound like the soundtrack of any 1970s American car chase movie, the band Sven Hammond Soul is from the Netherlands. This steaming soul machine is headed by Sven Figee, who prefers to attack rather than play his Hammond organ. In April 2012, the band was augmented with vocalist Jenny Lane. Today’s recordings were made at a steaming live performance at Utrecht’s Tivoli in 2012.

programme.title: Etienne Mbappe - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Marcus Miller: Thoughts on Miles
programme.desc: This portrait of Marcus Miller was recorded during his 2009 ‘Tutu Revisited’ tour. Miller looks back on his relationship with Miles Davis. Miller tells us about writing his composition 'Tutu', and shares countless stories of the recording process of the album 'Tutu'. This documentary was filmed in 2009 at the 'We Want Miles' exhibition in Cité de la Musique in Paris.

programme.title: Jim Hall And Atilla Zoller - Extensions
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery’s virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year.

programme.title: Moanin'
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Hackensack
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Wolfert Brederode
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Blue Note: A Story of Modern Jazz - Part I
programme.desc: Art Blakey, Dexter Gordon, Ron Carter, Herbie Hancock, Thelonious Monk... these names are synonymous with the great Jazz Age. But how many people know Alfred Lion and Francis Wolff, to whom we owe the recorded memory of our Jazz legends? Two German Jews who emigrated from Nazi Germany to New York 'discovered' an American art form which at the time received little serious attention from mainstream America: Jazz Music.

programme.title: Aki Rissanen Trio at Jazzclub Unterfahrt, Munich
programme.desc: Aki Rissanen's interest in jazz came after he started taking classical piano lessons. His deep interest in improvised music placed him among top jazz pianist in his home country - Finland. While composing and performing his own music, Rissanen has also collaborated with Verneri Pohjola and Dave Liebman, and today his name appears among the top European jazz musicians.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1978, the famed Chicago Blues All Star Band put on an electrifying performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: The Garifuna Collektive - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Benny Goodman Septet - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1982, legendary jazz clarinettist Benny Goodman performed at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague with his septet.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Sessions: Linus
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Kenny Barron, Baila
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: Ray Charles live at North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.

programme.title: He's My Guy
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: LBT - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city. Among the artists of 2019 is the German Leo Betzl Trio.

programme.title: Casper the Funky Ghost: Bootsy Collins à Vienne
programme.desc: Bootsy Collins, famed for playing with George Clinton and his very own Rubber Band, is used to playing syncopated, hard and relentlessly rhythmic music. With this unique style Bootsy was a major influence on the development of funk. Now in his 60s, the bassist seems animated by a new energy that reflects his new work on the album ‘Tha Funk Capitol of the World’.

programme.title: Where Are We Now - Set 2
programme.desc: German jazz and cabaret singer Atrin Madani was born in 1998 as the son of Iranian immigrants. In the face of pandemic uncertainty, geopolitical upheaval, and social unrest in his ancestral home country, Madani asked himself: where are we now? His response to this question is as clear and precise as his singing: what we need most right now is honesty, humility, and quality.

programme.title: Tania Maria: Live at Estival Lugano 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. This performance of Brazilian Tania Maria promises to make you want to dance.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Red Right Hand - A Vingança
programme.desc: Cash está tentando viver uma vida honesta e tranquila, mas quando Big Cat o força a voltar aos seus serviços, ele se mostra capaz de qualquer coisa para proteger a cidade e a única família que lhe resta.

Quando terroristas tentam assumir o controle de um voo Berlim-Paris, um co-piloto americano de fala mansa luta para salvar a vida dos passageiros e da tripulação enquanto forja uma conexão surpreendente com um dos sequestradores.

programme.title: Robocop, o Polícia do Futuro
programme.desc: Em Detroit, uma organização cria um polícia robot para substituir os polícias normais, mas um executivo pretende tirar partido em benefício próprio.

programme.title: Robocop 2
programme.desc: Na cidade de Detroit, com a polícia em greve, só Robocop reage, mas um poderoso conglomerado tenta domesticá-lo para atingir a sua estratégia de poder.

programme.title: Resgate Bilionário
programme.desc: Os estudantes de um reformatório para miúdos ricos e rebeldes decidem defender-se pelos seus próprios meios, quando as instalações da escola são tomadas por um grupo de criminosos.

programme.title: Sem Identidade
programme.desc: Após um acidente de carro em Berlim, Dr. Martin Harris acorda e descobre que a sua mulher, estranhamente não o reconhece e que outro homem assumiu a sua identidade.

programme.title: Pensamento Crítico
programme.desc: A história da equipa de xadrez da Miami Jackson High School formada por jovens inteligentes e sonhadores que ficaram conhecidos como o primeiro grupo da região a vencer o Campeonato Nacional de Xadrez dos Estados Unidos.

programme.title: A Voz Das Mulheres
programme.desc: Não faça nada, fique e lute ou vá embora. Em 2010, as mulheres de uma comunidade religiosa isolada lutam para reconciliar uma realidade brutal com sua fé.

programme.title: Ligação de Alto Risco
programme.desc: Uma mulher vítima de sequestro consegue contactar o telemóvel de um homem que se lança sozinho nesta aventura e que irá tentar salvá-la.

programme.title: Correio De Droga
programme.desc: Earl Stone é um octogenário que se encontra falido e sozinho. Quando a sua empresa lhe propõe um trabalho que exige simplesmente conduzir, a tarefa parece simples. Mas sem que se aperceba, Earl vê-se contratado por um cartel de droga mexicano...

programme.title: San Andreas
programme.desc: Depois de um sismo de magnitude 9 afetar a Califórnia, um piloto de helicóptero de resgate e salvamento e a ex-mulher tentam salvar a sua única filha. Mas isto é apenas o início. E quando eles pensam que o pior já passou... está na verdade a começar.

programme.title: Samaritan
programme.desc: Um menino descobre que um super-herói que se pensava ter morrido após uma batalha épica há vinte e cinco anos pode de fato ainda estar vivo

programme.title: No Time To Die
programme.desc: James Bond deixou o serviço ativo. Sua paz dura pouco quando Felix Leiter, um velho amigo da CIA, aparece pedindo ajuda, levando Bond ao rastro de um misterioso vilão armado com uma nova tecnologia perigosa.

programme.title: Ninja Americano 4
programme.desc: Os dois ninjas americanos, Joe Armstrong e Sean Davidson,unem se para lutar contra um terrorista e seu bando de ninjas.

programme.title: Big Kill - Cidade do Medo
programme.desc: Um burguês, dois jogadores desajustados e um religioso assassino acabam numa cidade em franca expansão, chamada apenas de Big Kill.

programme.title: Robocop 3, Fora da Lei
programme.desc: Um grupo japonês tenta construir uma cidade futurista em substituição de um bairro de Detroit. Os habitantes são despejados à força e surge Robocop em seu auxílio.

programme.title: Robocop (2014)
programme.desc: Em 2028, após ser fatalmente ferido em ação, o agente Alex Murphy é salvo pela empresa que domina o mercado da tecnologia robótica. Regressa às ruas de Detroit assoladas pelo crime, com um conjunto de novas capacidades como o primeiro polícia ciborgue.

programme.title: Zoom In
programme.desc: Um olhar pelos bastidores dos filmes de maior sucesso de Hollywood.

programme.title: Os Excluídos
programme.desc: Em 1970, um professor de história rabugento em um internato da Nova Inglaterra permanece no campus durante as férias de Natal para supervisionar os alunos retidos e acaba formando um vínculo improvável com um encrenqueiro inteligente, mas danificado.

programme.title: Oppenheimer
programme.desc: Uma dramatização da história de vida de J. Robert Oppenheimer, o físico que teve uma grande participação no desenvolvimento das bombas atômicas que puseram fim à Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: Os Sete Magníficos
programme.desc: Um remake do clássico Os Sete Magníficos, onde a população desesperada de Rose Creek contrata a proteção de sete marginais. Enquanto preparam a cidade para um violento confronto, os sete mercenários acabam a lutar por mais do que apenas dinheiro.

programme.title: Conclave
programme.desc: Quando o cardeal Lawrence é encarregado de liderar um dos eventos mais secretos e antigos do mundo, selecionando um novo papa, ele se encontra no centro de uma teia de conspirações e intrigas que podem abalar os próprios alicerces da Igreja Católica.

programme.title: No Limite do Amanhã
programme.desc: Quando a Terra é invadida por uma impiedosa e imbatível raça alienígena, o inexperiente Major William Cage é arrastado para a linha da frente. Morre em poucos minutos, mas entra numa repetição temporal que o força a reviver o combate vezes sem conta.

programme.title: Noite em Fuga
programme.desc: Jimmy Conlon, um mafioso assassino de Brooklyn já viu melhores dias. Amigo de longa data do chefe da máfia, Jimmy, atualmente com 55 anos, é perseguido pelos erros do passado e por um obstinado detetive da polícia, que o procura há 30 anos.

programme.title: O Agente das Sombras
programme.desc: Travis Block é um agente do governo que está a lidar com o seu passado sombrio. Quando descobre uma conspiração que visa cidadãos americanos, Block vê-se na mira do diretor do FBI que outrora ajudou a proteger.

programme.title: The Gunman - O Atirador
programme.desc: Jim Terrier é um ex-agente governamental cujo passado regressa para o atormentar quando é atraiçoado e se vê no centro de uma conspiração que pretende vê-lo morto. Para sobreviver, Terrier tem de destruir uma poderosa organização mundial.

programme.title: Assalto à 13ª Esquadra
programme.desc: O reduzido pessoal de um posto de polícia tem de se unir aos prisioneiros aí detidos para conseguirem enfrentar um ataque de assaltantes mascarados.

programme.title: Hellboy (2019)
programme.desc: Hellboy volta para combater um trio de gigantes enfurecidos, quando descobre a Rainha de Sangue, Nimue, uma antiga feiticeira ressuscitada em busca de vingança. Preso numa luta entre Sobrenatural e Humano, Hellboy tem de impedir os planos de Nimue...

programme.title: Charli XCX - Reading And Leeds Festival 2022

programme.title: Paul Simon - Live in New York City

The show presents this iconic artist working at the peak of his artistic and creative powers in an unusually intimate setting. The 20-song, 90-minute set list was drawn from his legendary career and includes several songs that haven't been performed live in many years.

programme.title: 2CELLOS - Live in London 2011

programme.title: John Lee Hooker - Live At Montreux 1990

programme.title: Paul Rodgers - Free Spirit
programme.desc: The 16-song collection, 'Free Spirit', filmed in London, England returned Paul Rodgers to his roots, bringing fans an extraordinary evening celebrating the music of Free.

programme.title: Coldplay - SXSW - Live in Austin

programme.title: The Black Keys - Live at Austin City Limits

programme.title: Peter Gabriel - New Blood: Live in London

programme.title: Various Artists - iConcerts Hits

programme.title: George Michael - Live in London

programme.title: Namastey London
programme.desc: On a trip to India, Jasmeet's father forcefully marries her off to Arjun. However, when they return to London, Jasmeet announces her intention of marrying her boyfriend, Charlie Brown.

programme.title: Section 375
programme.desc: A filmmaker stands trial when a costume assistant on his movie accuses him of rape.

programme.title: Luv Ki Arrange Marriage
programme.desc: Luv is in love with Ishika and wants to ask for her hand in marriage. A laughter riot follows when his widowed father falls in love with Ishika's mother. Which couple has a more successful love story?.

programme.title: Style
programme.desc: Best friends Bantu and Chantu try make two wealthy girls fall in love with them. However, they find out that the girls have been murdered and become prime suspects.

programme.title: Naseeb
programme.desc: When Pooja's father disapproves of her relation with Krishna, a humble man, he vows to become wealthy and returns to find that she is already married.

programme.title: Sukhee
programme.desc: Fed up with her mundane existence, a housewife gets to relive the past while attending a school reunion.

programme.title: Nehlle Pe Dehlla
programme.desc: Two small-time crooks, Jimmy and Johny, blackmail hotel manager Balram Sahni aka Ballu in order to get a huge sum of money. But their plan goes haywire when Ballu is mysteriously murdered.

programme.title: Satyameva Jayate 2
programme.desc: In a fight against corruption, several people take a mighty stand to put an end to the social evils and establish a law-abiding society.

programme.title: Do Aur Do Paanch
programme.desc: Two rival burglars end up at the same school with the intent of abducting a rich man's son for a large ransom.

programme.title: Sardar Udham Singh
programme.desc: The life of Sardar Udham Singh, a revolutionary freedom fighter best known for assassinating Michael O'Dwyer in London to take revenge for 1919 Jallianwala Bagh massacre in Amritsar.

programme.title: 12Th Fail
programme.desc: IPS officer Manoj Kumar Sharma embarks on a fearless journey to restart his academic pursuit, aiming to conquer the world's toughest competitive exam.

programme.title: Chehre
programme.desc: An 80-year-old man with a penchant for real life games in a story about rights and wrongs.

programme.title: Operation Valentine

programme.title: Meri Pyaari Bindu
programme.desc: Childhood friends Abhimanyu and Bindu face friction when she realises that she doesn't love him after a brief relationship. Years later, Abhimanyu decides to pen a story based on his life.

programme.title: Phir Aayi Hasseen Dillruba
programme.desc: Escaping from the police in Agra, Rani and Rishu decide to elope together. When their plan goes awry, Rani seeks a helping hand from a kind admirer.

programme.title: Kantara
programme.desc: When greed paves the way for betrayal, scheming and murder, a young tribal reluctantly dons the traditions of his ancestors to seek justice.

programme.title: Aankh Micholi
programme.desc: Three cousins, Laadli Chibber, Bajrang Das Khatri and Shikhar Randhawa, embrace the warmth of a new city when they move to Mumbai, but they also face challenges that transform their lives.

programme.title: Jaaneman
programme.desc: Suhaan, an aspiring actor, is in a fix when Piya files for divorce and forces him to pay a large amount as alimony. To avoid paying her, Suhaan uses Agastya's love for Piya and helps him woo her.
